## Backing Platform (ArtCraft)

- [Backing Platform (ArtCraft)](https://knuckles-team.github.io/craft-suite-api/platform/) — craft-suite-api is a client of a backing service instance. This page provides a Docker recipe for deploying one locally as an operator-selected provider endpoint.
